headline_stat.name: significantly precessing fields (neg slope, p<0.05) / total; median slope

justification.dataset: DANDI 000044 Achilles CA1 linear-track session is the canonical dataset for hippocampal theta phase precession.
justification.handling: Real data streamed from DANDI, MAZE epoch isolated, excitatory CA1 units filtered by spike count, theta channel chosen by theta/delta ratio, position NaNs interpolated — all correct and justified.
justification.analysis: Direction-specific place fields, Skaggs-information selection, Kempter circular-linear regression on Hilbert theta phase, and a phase-shuffle permutation test constitute the standard, correctly-applied method with the required null.
justification.correctness: All headline numbers (88/53/5, median slope -183.6, median rho -0.238) reproduce exactly from the committed npz and are internally consistent with the figures and adequate sample size.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and n, show unambiguous descending phase-vs-position bands, and examples are ranked by correlation strength rather than slope magnitude.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to the strong result and nothing is misrepresented, but no specific limitation (single session, borderline cases) is stated, keeping it at 3.
justification.verdict: A textbook, reproducible demonstration of theta precession on the canonical dataset that I would accept as-is.
